summary: 当晚 ACDE #239 把 EIP-8282 列为考虑纳入 Glamsterdam，devnet-6 目标下周中，并确认 EIP-7904 转为 Informational，因为客户端超过 100 Mgas/s 目标，无需计算重定价。chunter-cb 合并两项 EIP-8130 存储模型修改：默认 EOA 的撤销改为状态标志，自身 secp256k1 配置内联到账户状态槽，一次 SLOAD 即可解析。morph-dev 提交 EIP-8141 规范清理。pcaversaccio 在 ethresear.ch 提出基于 Tor Browser 的以太坊隐私浏览器 Etherveil。Hsiao-Wei Wang 卸任 EF 联合执行董事。

items.title: EIP-2780 改为按资源拆解交易固有 gas
items.note: 同日合并的 gas 规范：EIP-2780 改为按资源拆解交易固有 gas（misilva73），标准转账仍是 21000，但由 `TX_BASE_COST + COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS + TX_VALUE_COST + TRANSFER_LOG_COST` 组成；EIP-8279 BAL 字节下限（nerolation），把 BAL 数据计入 EIP-7623 calldata 下限以降低最坏区块大小；EIP-8037 与 EIP-7928 冲突的解决；EIP-8038 初步数值。

items.topic: EIP-8130 存储模型与 EIP-8141 清理
items.title: EIP-8130：把默认 EOA 撤销并入状态标志
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并。移除 `REVOKED_AUTHENTICATOR` 哨兵值：此前撤销隐式 EOA actor 要用魔数地址 `type(uint160).max` 覆盖其 `actor_config` 槽；现在用状态标志表示，并统一 secp256k1 认证路径，不改交易线上格式，默认更安全。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: fold default EOA revocation into a state flag
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged. It removes the `REVOKED_AUTHENTICATOR` sentinel: revoking the implicit EOA actor used to mean overwriting its `actor_config` slot with the magic address `type(uint160).max`; now a state flag represents it and the secp256k1 authentication path is unified, with no wire format change and a safer default.
items.topic_en: The EIP-8130 storage model and EIP-8141 cleanup

items.topic: EIP-8130 存储模型与 EIP-8141 清理
items.title: EIP-8130：自身 actor 的 secp256k1 配置内联到账户状态槽
items.note: 提交并合并。默认 EOA 的 `scope`、`policyType`、`expiry` 与 `DEFAULT_EOA_REVOKED` 放在同一个 32 字节账户状态槽中，账户自己的密钥（包括有范围限制的自身密钥）一次 SLOAD 即可解析。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: store the self-actor secp256k1 config inline in the account state slot
items.note_en: Submitted and merged. The default EOA's `scope`, `policyType` and `expiry` live in the same 32-byte account state slot as `DEFAULT_EOA_REVOKED`, so the account's own key, including a scoped self, resolves in a single SLOAD.
items.topic_en: The EIP-8130 storage model and EIP-8141 cleanup

items.topic: EIP-8130 存储模型与 EIP-8141 清理
items.title: EIP-8141：规范清理与澄清
items.note: （morph-dev）提交：`sig.signer` 可为空，默认为 `tx.sender`；所有 `sig_hash` 都省略原始 `sig.signature` 字节，因为交易有效要求所有签名有效，承诺 `sig.msg` 已间接承诺签名，若不省略，未来就无法做签名聚合；mempool 部分涉及过期验证 frame 等。
items.note_en: (morph-dev), submitted: `sig.signer` may be empty and defaults to `tx.sender`; raw `sig.signature` bytes are left out of every `sig_hash`, since all signatures must be valid for the transaction to be valid, committing to `sig.msg` already commits to the signatures indirectly, and including them would block future signature aggregation; the mempool section covers the expiry verifier frame and more.
items.topic_en: The EIP-8130 storage model and EIP-8141 cleanup

summary_en: In the evening ACDE #239 listed EIP-8282 as considered for inclusion in Glamsterdam, targeted devnet-6 for mid next week, and confirmed EIP-7904 becomes Informational because clients exceed the 100 Mgas/s target and need no compute repricing. chunter-cb merged two EIP-8130 storage model changes: revoking the default EOA becomes a state flag, and the account's own secp256k1 config is inlined into the account state slot so it resolves in one SLOAD. morph-dev submitted an EIP-8141 spec cleanup. pcaversaccio proposed Etherveil, an Ethereum privacy browser built on Tor Browser, on ethresear.ch. Hsiao-Wei Wang stepped down as EF co-executive director.
